name: com.gameframex.unity.operationclipboard.alipayminigame
displayName: Game Frame X Operation Clipboard (Alipay Mini Game)
description:
Alipay Mini Game clipboard adapter for GameFrameX OperationClipboard. Implements IOperationClipboardManager over the Alipay clipboard SDK, whose JSON-callback APIs only allow reading in enterprise-subject mini games, and self-registers into OperationClipboardRegistry at BeforeSceneLoad via AliPayMiniGameOperationClipboardBootstrap (code is stripped and registration does not happen when UNITY_WEBGL / ENABLE_ALIPAY_MINI_GAME / ENABLE_ALIPAY_MINI_GAME_OPERATIONCLIPBOARD macros are not enabled — referencing means registering). Docs: https://gameframex.doc.alianblank.com

GameFrameX OperationClipboard 的支付宝小游戏粘贴板适配渠道包。基于支付宝 JSON 字符串回调式剪贴板 API 实现（读取仅企业主体小程序可用），由 AliPayMiniGameOperationClipboardBootstrap 在 BeforeSceneLoad 阶段自注册进主包 OperationClipboardRegistry（宏 UNITY_WEBGL / ENABLE_ALIPAY_MINI_GAME / ENABLE_ALIPAY_MINI_GAME_OPERATIONCLIPBOARD 未启用时代码被裁剪、注册不发生，引用即注册）。文档：https://gameframex.doc.alianblank.com
